title: Count countries by starting letter
description: Write a function `starting_letter_counts(countries)` that returns a dict mapping each starting letter of the names in `countries` to how many names start with it.
starter_code:

hints: Idea to consider: collections.Counter over each name's first character
c[0] for c in countries gives just the starting letters; Counter over that sequence tallies how many times each one occurs, the same way it tallies whole words elsewhere.
Return dict(Counter(c[0] for c in countries)).
expected_behavior: Returns a dict of starting letter to count.
explanation: Counter doesn't care what it's counting - here it's the first character of each name rather than a whole word, but the tallying mechanism is identical to the word-frequency exercises from Days 18-19.
